The scorer's 4D-S1 line-word reader reads the words around the figure in the requirement text whether or not the parser had to skip the 0.3 m definition. No other row moves; a falling floor or an unlisted move is a STOP. The 172 and 4d pins change in totals, table_version unchanged, scorer_sha only.
